title: SID MEDICOS, South Korean aesthetics company, strengthens its commitment to Mexico at Dermacosmética 2026
summary: SID MEDICOS, a global company specialising in beauty and aesthetics, will participate in Dermacosmética 2026 with the aim of connecting with industry professionals in Mexico and exploring new opportunities for collaboration in the country

extraction.key_fact: 한국의 에스테틱 기업 SID MEDICOS가 멕시코 업계 관계자들과 교류하고 협력 기회를 모색하기 위해 Dermacosmética 행사에 참가한다.
